timeline.text: Click into one of my projects, and you'd see a few hardcoded sentences I wrote once — nothing about the work since.
It's like a shop window that's never restocked, no matter how much changes inside.
Now a Supabase-backed endpoint reads each project's real tech stack and newest work automatically.
Every project page refreshes itself, on desktop and mobile, without me touching a thing.
All 13 projects now show up to 8 tech tags and their 6 newest features, updated every 10 minutes.
